title: Research: fixed paired26 completion minimum 62 with exact certificates
head: 712a9b9aa8802d0135a578c0debee7b56c8e492f
body:
For woklerx's PR1020 fixed 26-line puncture and exact ordered normal pair
(48, 0), this supplies an eight-term rational all-pairs decoder with separate
COPY cost **62**, profile **[6,8,8,8,8,8,8,8]**, improving that object's prior
complete decoder cost **69**. The puncture and cost-six first pair remain
credited predecessor results.

The written proof gives a matching lower bound over arbitrary complex
coefficients without assuming F6, classifies 256 optimal residual classes,
and proves an attained 67-cost bound in the reduced-A branch. Scope fixes
the exact pair/scaling, all eight terms, ordinary transpose, all 8,836
ordered live pairs and actual-support binary-rank charges. No global
26-puncture optimum or physical supplier, paid rank-shape, moment, or kappa
improvement is claimed.

The package includes the proof, deterministic certificate, primary exact
checker and separate Fraction-elimination audit. Both checkers were authored
in the same GPT-6 Pro research session. Codex separately authenticated the
pinned predecessor bytes and transcribed data, audited execution and replayed
both programs on CPython 3.12.14 in normal and optimized modes. The registered
optimized replay passes in about 3.3 seconds. It reconstructs 511 functional
records, 1,716 candidate seven-subsets and four full all-pairs examples;
14 primary rejection controls, two complex controls and a fresh saved-file
mutation check pass. The 256 census is a basis-set census, not 256 expanded
entrywise complex replays.

A separate GPT-6 Pro written review reports corroboration of the minimum,
classification and branch bound, independently recomputing the 511 kernels,
1,716 subsets and cost-62 witness and constructing its own cost-67 witness.
It also reports checking all 256 normalized optimal bases entrywise. The
complete transferred review was read and requests no repair. Its separate
programs, certificates and logs were not retrieved or replayed locally.
It did not audit the supplied programs or prior 69 baseline. These are scoped
finite replays and a written proof/review, not human or kernel certification.

Reproduce with Python 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-paired26-completion
```

This closes the bounded [Discussion1570](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1570)
follow-up to [PR1521](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1521).
A final overlap refresh covered 732 open PRs and 253 Discussion records on
2026-10-14 at 04:08-04:09 UTC, with complete pagination and no matching
fixed-P26 completion found. Coverage is not a novelty certificate.
Historical revision-2 assignment/source pins are retained, with the current
revision-3 checkpoint recorded. A complete physical interface and paid-moment
screen remain open; this algebraic checkpoint does not establish their
headroom.

Credit: woklerx (PR1020/PR1077), Hanson Sun / @bbMisk (PR1521), themilkman216
(PR968), DreamingOfClouds (PR717), and their retained lineage. Prepared for
Andrey Mas with substantial GPT-6 Pro research through ChatGPT; Codex source
coordination, local mechanical verification and packaging. Apache-2.0.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
